titre: Le progiciel de gestion intégré reste minoritaire en Europe
sous_titre: Part des entreprises de l'Union européenne utilisant un progiciel de gestion intégré, en %, enquête 2025
categories: Commerce de gros et de détail

series.nom: Entreprises utilisant un progiciel de gestion intégré

Ensemble des entreprises.texte: The percentage of EU enterprises that used ERP software applications reached 46.45% in 2025, an increase by 3.07 pp compared with 2023

Information et communication.texte: more than 60% of enterprises in information and communication sector (61.28%) used ERP

Industrie manufacturière.texte: Shares of enterprises using ERP higher than 50% were registered also in manufacturing (57.62%)

Hébergement et restauration.texte: The lowest rates of adoption of ERP software were recorded in accommodation and food service activities (26.69%)
